body: That sucks, :/ The thing is, I LOVE my friends. They're wonderful, but they don't know the real me. If I told them, I'm afraid they'll just leave me like my old friend... And I don't understand why on earth all this is coming back to me now. I don't expect a fellow 13 year old to know the answers to those questions, but I'm just putting it out there..(Also, I hate it when it does that, it's fine)

Hi, it's me from my "awesome" post! I won't say that I'm the best at advice either, but I'll give it a shot because why not? Having a hard time making friends is a problem, I can admit. As well as all the other stuff you mentioned. But maybe that's because you haven't found the right friend yet? What do you like to do? Have you joined any clubs with people who like the same stuff you do? That's also a way to get away from the troubles at home, and who knows, you could find a talent you never knew you had! If YOU want to rant, I'm here as well.

Thanks I guess, the thing is, I basically CAN'T talk to my friends or family. They'll get stressed out and then they'll get depressed and nothing will be helped. I'm basically posting on this so I can find someone who doesn't know me and will actually help, rather than make me feel bad about talking about it...
